# Open Design Load fixtures

`buildings` contains the synthetic simultaneous design-load fixture matrix for
`designload`. `reference` contains independent hand/PsychroLib comparison metrics
and an explicitly labeled pre-refactor regression baseline. The regression file
is not an independent oracle. Real OpenStudio-HPXML output remains pending under
`../openstudio`; psychrometric primitive cases live under `../physics`.

Future model suites should be scoped separately. National and dynamic model
results are not required to agree with this methodology's results.
